Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: clock_descriptor_still_unqualified.
Assessment: New source correction and ASR receipts do not establish annotation/scanner equivalence or the complete scene-task descriptor.
Staleness: Eight-film/media-missing wording predates current11FilmFestival clips. The frozen task population must not silently expand.
Remaining / next action: Reuse current media/transform receipts; explicitly reconcile original registered film set against current11clip inventory; retain bus_stop shortfall, mm.ss/Run2 ordinal courts and unestablished offsets.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Qualify FilmFestival Run2 ordinal map, mm.ss parsing and actual per-film clock/media equivalence before scene-within-film scoring. Record bus_stop shortfall; do not reuse annotation/scanner authority interchangeably.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b (FilmFestival task).

Scene within film needs: the +106 renumbering of Run-2 segments, run-relative min.sec times parsed as mm.ss, the annotation-clock vs BIDS-clock offset (title cards; the cartoon at BIDS onset 3 s), and media equivalence (bus_stop is 8 s short).

Scope:
Make the clock and ordinal mapping explicit and tested; add the task descriptor for the eight films with media.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The Run-2 +106 renumbering is a declared ordinal map in the descriptor or intake layer, not a constant in scorer code.
2. Run-relative min.sec times are parsed as mm.ss with 2-dp rounding; tests cover dirty floats such as 6.1000000000000005.
3. The annotation-clock offset is established against the local media and recorded with frame or audio timestamps.
4. Per-film media equivalence (clip vs scan duration) is recorded, with bus_stop's shortfall explicit.
5. A scene-within-film task descriptor exists for the eight films with media.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
